families.title: What we build
families.lead: Five families, nine base models. Each one exists because a distribution problem needed solving, not because a catalogue needed filling.

classes.title: Two classes
classes.lead: The distinction most competitors don't state, and the one that sets the real cost of a supply.

classA.label: Class A
classA.transport: Single-piece load on a standard trailer. No special permit. Stackable, handled with ISO equipment.
classA.use: Site facilities, housing, sanitary units, emergency response, aggregations.

classB.label: Class B
classB.transport: Flat-pack for transport, assembled on site. A single-piece load needs an oversize permit.

cutting.body: Steel profiles cut and shaped to the frame drawings.

welding.title: Welding and treatment
welding.body: The frame is welded, then treated against corrosion.

insulation.title: Insulation and cladding
insulation.body: Sandwich panels close the frame: floor, walls, roof.

systems.title: Systems
systems.body: Electrical and plumbing runs go in before the finishes.

finishing.title: Finishing and testing
finishing.body: Fixtures, fittings, and a full functional test.

loading.title: Loading
loading.body: Onto the trailer, ready to leave the yard.
